nvitk.gui.viz.left_dock
=======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.left_dock

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Shared Napari left-dock placement for cross-section and hemodynamics panels.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.viz.left_dock.attach_left_inspection_dock


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: attach_left_inspection_dock(viewer: Any, panel: Any, *, object_name: str, title: str, tabify_with: str | list[str] | None = None, minimum_width: int = 280) -> Any

   Attach *panel* on Napari's left edge, optionally tabified with another dock.

   ``tabify_with`` may be a single dock object name or an ordered list of
   candidates; the first existing dock is used as the tab target.
